title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省 Jones市镇 Dibuluan 小学的名称变更为Jones 东中央学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Dibuluan Elementary School in the Municipality of Jones, Province of Isabela, To Jones East Central School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Dibuluan Elementary School in the Municipality of Jones, Province of Isabela, To Jones East Central School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Dibuluan tại Thị trấn Jones, Tỉnh Isabela thành Jones East Central School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Dibuluan ในเทศบาล Jones, จังหวัด Isabela เป็น Jones East Central School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Dibuluan di Kotamadya Jones, Provinsi Isabela menjadi Jones East Central School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Dibuluan di Perbandaran Jones, Wilayah Isabela menjadi Jones East Central School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7468_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Dibuluan Elementary School in the Municipality of Jones, Province of Isabela, is hereby changed to Jones East Central School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
